about: Five floating screeds of concrete or asphalt strips on a bare concrete floor, from Table 19.3 of the Spanish edition of the first Handbook of Noise Control, with the average improvement in impact sound insulation each one gives, in decibels, as Table 19.2 prints it for floor finishes.
